# Framework-only services bookkeeping observation

## Executable route

Use `adb -s SERIAL shell dumpsys activity services` **only in the independent diagnostic's existing service-snapshot command slot**. Do not add commands in the absence interval; keep the original all-process-absence gate and its existing package-filtered command unchanged.

In the exact run116 installed framework, `services` already passes `dumpAll=true`. With no trailing matcher, `ItemMatcher.all` remains true, which permits `dumpRemainsLocked()` to print ActiveForegroundApps. With no `-p`/`-c`, `dumpClient` remains false and the non-client `dumpLocked()` path is selected. This prints framework fields without invoking `IApplicationThread.dumpService`. It still takes AMS locks and changes command-output/timing cost; no timing-neutral or runtime-stack claim follows.

A positional package makes `ItemMatcher.all=false`; `-a services PACKAGE` therefore still omits the foreground map. Leading `-p PACKAGE` restores package-specific map selection but also enables client dumping: `dumpServiceClient()` can call an application and wait up to 2000ms. Do not use that route for this observer.

## Exact installed-bytecode anchors

`services.jar` SHA256 `1d241dbf234d4773e80fc0d0fd137920bb4c5b1d1ce51b3ddf79d1afbc65a6c6`; classes.dex dexdump SHA256 `5c1882408308b5d27ef5c19f7a5f161af43f67cabf0bd3d176d5df3b68f42b6d`. Byte-preserving line excerpts and their hashes are in `source-manifest.json`.

- AMS `doDump`, services non-client path: lines 1662776–1662797; literal true at +06ba, `newServiceDumperLocked` +06c5, `dumpLocked` +06c9.
- ServiceDumper `dumpRemainsLocked`: ItemMatcher.all gate +01c6/+01c8; foreground output starts +021f. `mNumActive` read +0264; `mAppOnTop` +0272; shown flags +0280/+028e. Start/visible times are formatted relative to the dump's clock; optional end-time branch compares stored value at +02b7–02bd and prints its relative duration at +02c1–02d0. Summary preserves printed text and omission separately, not an invented zero or absolute timestamp.
- `dumpServiceClient`, code_item 0x2a46a8: null app/thread short-circuits, but otherwise invokes application dump at +0023 and TransferPipe wait with 2000ms at +002d/+002f. A prior null sample cannot ensure a later client callback will remain impossible.

## Official source corroboration

- [AMS doDump services branch](https://github.com/aosp-mirror/platform_frameworks_base/blob/android-15.0.0_r1/services/core/java/com/android/server/am/ActivityManagerService.java#L11008-L11019); [-p client flag](https://github.com/aosp-mirror/platform_frameworks_base/blob/android-15.0.0_r1/services/core/java/com/android/server/am/ActivityManagerService.java#L10710-L10718); [ItemMatcher](https://github.com/aosp-mirror/platform_frameworks_base/blob/android-15.0.0_r1/services/core/java/com/android/server/am/ActivityManagerService.java#L11692).
- [ServiceDumper local/client paths](https://github.com/aosp-mirror/platform_frameworks_base/blob/android-15.0.0_r1/services/core/java/com/android/server/am/ActiveServices.java#L7750-L7824); [foreground map gate and printed fields](https://github.com/aosp-mirror/platform_frameworks_base/blob/android-15.0.0_r1/services/core/java/com/android/server/am/ActiveServices.java#L8044-L8092).

## Interpretation and next execution

The host parser selects only user 0's exact `app.passengercount` map entry and `TrackService` records, retaining token/listing/count/type/sticky fields and six restriction reasons. Native capture completion, stdout/stderr/status/scope identities and hashes are bound per source; random attempt directory names do not establish chronology. Missing sections, missing target entries, and transport/parse incompleteness are distinct. No map result proves UID/process absence, a runtime caller, causation, recovery, or acceptance.

After exact-head review/natural hosted validation, compare each retained token's pre-detach and later records against the sampled map `mNumActive`, `mAppOnTop`, and printed end-time. Pair with the existing death/UID-gone/absence evidence; no extra UID command is currently needed. This can distinguish sampled bookkeeping patterns, but cannot replace the unavailable framework runtime transition trace or prove the reset caller.
